```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(gradethis)
library(shiny)
source("R/app_config.R")
source("R/question_manifest.R")
source("R/assignment_storage.R")
source("R/syntax_checkers.R")

gradethis::gradethis_setup(
  pass.praise = FALSE,
  fail.encourage = FALSE,
  fail.hint = FALSE
)

learnr::tutorial_options(
  exercise.timelimit = 10,
  exercise.reveal_solution = FALSE
)
```

```{r logging-start, context="server-start", include=FALSE}
library(httr2)
source("R/logging.R")
register_logging_handlers(APP_CONFIG)
```

```{r identity-server, context="server", include=FALSE}
session$userData$identity <- shiny::reactiveVal(NULL)
session$userData$assignment_ids <- shiny::reactiveVal(
  stats::setNames(character(), character())
)
session$userData$logging_status <- shiny::reactiveVal(
  list(ok = NA, message = "Enter your student ID to load this week's assignment.")
)

clear_assignment_player <- function() {
  session$userData$assignment_ids(stats::setNames(character(), character()))
  session$sendCustomMessage("assignment:clear", list())
}

shiny::observeEvent(input$save_identity, {
  student_id <- trimws(input$student_id)
  student_name <- trimws(input$student_name)

  if (!grepl("^[A-Za-z0-9._@-]{2,100}$", student_id)) {
    clear_assignment_player()
    session$userData$logging_status(list(
      ok = FALSE,
      message = "Enter a valid student ID (2–100 letters, digits, ., _, @, or -)."
    ))
    return()
  }

  manifest <- read_question_manifest()
  assignments <- tryCatch(
    initialize_student_assignments(
      student_id = student_id,
      manifest = manifest,
      config = APP_CONFIG
    ),
    error = function(e) e
  )

  if (inherits(assignments, "error")) {
    clear_assignment_player()
    session$userData$logging_status(list(
      ok = FALSE,
      message = paste("Could not load your assignment:", conditionMessage(assignments))
    ))
    return()
  }

  session$userData$assignment_ids(assignment_id_map(assignments))
  session$userData$identity(list(
    student_id = student_id,
    student_name = student_name
  ))

  session$sendCustomMessage(
    "assignment:set",
    list(item_labels = unname(as.character(assignments$item_label)))
  )

  post_log_event(
    session,
    "identity_saved",
    data = list(label = "identity"),
    config = APP_CONFIG
  )
})

output$identity_status <- shiny::renderUI({
  status <- session$userData$logging_status()
  cls <- if (isTRUE(status$ok)) {
    "alert alert-success"
  } else if (identical(status$ok, FALSE)) {
    "alert alert-danger"
  } else {
    "alert alert-warning"
  }
  shiny::tags$div(class = cls, status$message)
})
```

## Before you begin

Your responses are graded immediately and recorded for your instructor. Enter the same student ID your course uses for grading. Your assignment is fixed once it is created for the current week; reopening the app with the same ID returns the same questions.

```{r identity-ui, echo=FALSE}
shiny::wellPanel(
  shiny::textInput("student_id", "Student ID", placeholder = "e.g., abc123"),
  shiny::textInput("student_name", "Name (optional)", placeholder = "e.g., Ada Lovelace"),
  shiny::actionButton("save_identity", "Save identity and load assignment"),
  shiny::br(), shiny::br(),
  shiny::uiOutput("identity_status")
)
```
